# hi-command-spec-discovery: guide

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Produce draft-only special command or protocol wire-format specification from implementation code, including APDU/TLV fields, CLA/INS/P1/P2/Lc/Le framing, opcodes, status words, and command-specific models. Do not use for business scenarios, API contracts, or standalone behavior modeling.

## Invocation

```text
/hi-command-spec-discovery <module or command anchor> [command name|opcode|header] — draft-only
```

## Boundaries

- Do not use for business scenarios, API contracts, or standalone behavior modeling.
- Limits protect tools; they never prove completeness.
- Never invent or reformat tags, lengths, opcodes, transitions, or status words beyond verified evidence.

## What the skill covers

- Inputs
- Retrieval Gate
- Workflow
- Completion
